annotations.title: Website audit: accessibility (WCAG), SEO, security headers and page speed

description: Full website audit of one URL from a single load in a real browser: WCAG 2.1 A/AA accessibility violations with axe-core (rule, impact, elements, fix link), page speed (first byte, FCP, LCP, layout shift) and page weight by type, on-page SEO on the rendered page, and HTTP security headers with a grade. One overall score and the top issues. Use for a site or client report, before a launch, or to compare competitors. Example: url=https://www.wikipedia.org/. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
